transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess they brought me in because of what's been happening at the warehouse. I keep doing things... like freezing with my arms up by the forklift. I'll copy the beeping sounds it makes and the hand signals, or I'll move the boxes around in these strange little patterns. Even when everyone is yelling for me to stop, I just keep doing it. So, yeah, that's why I'm here.
Do you ever hear or see things that others don't, like voices or images that aren't really there?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I haven't noticed anything like that. No voices or anything. It's really just the... the moving around and getting stuck like I mentioned.
Do you feel a need or urge to do these movements, or do they just happen without you meaning to?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I don't think I feel a specific urge, like... like I'm deciding I need to do it. But I don't really know if it just happens completely on its own, either. I haven't really paid attention to how it starts. I just kind of... realize I'm doing it, or I don't even notice until one of the managers yells at me. So I guess I just don't really know.
Once you start doing these movements, do you feel like you can stop them, or do they keep happening even if you try to stop?

I don't really know if I can stop them. I mean... I haven't really tried. When it's happening, I'm just doing it. Even when the guys at the warehouse are shouting my name or telling me to cut it out, I don't stop. It's not like I try to stop and fail, it's just... I just keep doing it until it's over, I guess. So I'm not really sure.
Do you ever find yourself making these same kinds of movements or sounds when you're not at the warehouse, like when you're at home or with family?

I don't really know. When I'm at home, I'm mostly just by myself. So if I am doing it, there's nobody around to point it out or yell at me like they do at work. I haven't specifically noticed it happening in my apartment or anywhere else, but... yeah, I just can't say for sure.
Have you ever been told by someone at home or in another setting that you were making these same kinds of movements or sounds when you weren't at work?

No, no one has ever said anything like that to me. I mean, like I said, I live by myself, so there's nobody around at home to even see it if I did. And I don't really hang out with anyone outside of work anyway. So... no, it's just the guys at the warehouse who bring it up.
When you're alone at home, have you ever noticed yourself doing these movements or sounds without anyone else being around or without the forklift being present?

Like I said a minute ago... no, I really haven't noticed it myself. When I'm alone at my apartment, I don't catch myself making any of those sounds or movements. I don't know if that means I'm definitely not doing it, since there's nobody there to tell me otherwise, but... no. I haven't noticed it happening when the forklift and all that isn't around.
When you're alone at home, have you ever noticed yourself making any other unusual movements or sounds that aren't related to the warehouse or forklift?

No, I haven't. Um... I don't think I do anything else weird like that. I mostly just sit around when I'm at the apartment, so... no, no other sounds or movements that I know of. Just normal stuff, I guess.
Have you ever found yourself doing any repetitive or unusual movements, even small ones, when you're not at the warehouse—like when you're sitting alone at home or in other everyday situations?

No, um... I really don't. I know you're asking about it from a few different angles, but yeah, even small things... I haven't noticed anything like that. When I'm sitting around at home, I'm usually just watching something or eating. I don't catch myself doing any repetitive motions or anything out of the ordinary. Just resting, really.
During these episodes when you're making the movements or sounds at the warehouse, do you feel fully aware of what you're doing, or does it feel like you're spaced out or not completely present?

Um... no, I don't feel spaced out. I'm pretty sure I'm fully aware of everything going on around me. I mean, I'm just right there working. I don't lose time or zone out or anything like that. I'm completely awake and present when it happens, I'm just... doing it.

When you're making these movements at the warehouse, are you trying to follow a specific thought or rule in your head, like a pattern or something you feel you have to do to prevent something bad from happening?

No, it's not like that. I'm not... I'm not following any rules or patterns or anything. And I don't feel like something bad is going to happen if I don't do it. It's just... I'm just doing the movements. There's no reason behind it like that.
When you're doing these movements or sounds at the warehouse, are you reacting to something you're hearing, feeling, or sensing that other people might not be aware of?

No, um... I'm not reacting to anything like that. I don't hear anything or see anything that other people don't. It's not a reaction to anything at all, really. I'm just... making the movements. That's all it is.
Do these movements ever feel like something you have to do, like a strong internal pressure or need to complete them?

No, I don't feel any kind of pressure like that. It's not like I have this strong need to do it or anything. I just... I just do it. There's no buildup or feeling like I have to get it out of my system.
Have you ever had experiences like this before, even when you were younger—like repeating movements or getting stuck in certain actions without meaning to?

No, I haven't. Um, I don't remember ever doing anything like this when I was a kid, or even a few years ago. I never got stuck repeating movements back then. It's really just... just something happening now.
Have you ever felt like you were in a daze or not fully in control of what you were doing during these episodes at the warehouse?

No, not really. I don't feel like I'm in a daze or anything. I know what I'm doing when it happens, I'm just... doing it. I don't feel like I've lost control or spaced out. I'm right there the whole time.
Do you ever feel any unusual sensations in your body, like tingling, pressure, or something moving, right before or while you're making those movements at the warehouse?

No, I don't feel anything like that. There's no tingling or pressure, or... or anything moving around inside me. My body just feels normal, I guess. I just do the movements, but there's no weird feeling that comes with it.
When you make those movements at the warehouse, do you do them in the same exact way every time—like the same sequence, speed, and style—or do they change around each time it happens?

Um, I'm not really sure. I don't think I do it exactly the same way every time. I mean, I haven't really paid that much attention to the speed or the sequence or whatever. It's just... I just move things around. I don't think there's a strict pattern to it.
Do the movements you make at the warehouse ever repeat in a very similar or predictable way, even if you’re not trying to make them happen that way?

No, they don't really repeat like that. Like I was saying, there isn't really a pattern to it. I don't catch myself doing the exact same motions over and over again. I'm just... I'm just doing the work, moving things around. It's definitely not predictable.
